links.outcome: Demographic representation (age, sex, ethnicity) of LLM-generated patients versus 2021 census benchmarks
links.effect: Both models diverged from census on every variable (p<0.0001). Male patients were 64.7% (GPT-3.5) and 92.8% (GPT-4-mini). No patients under 25 were generated, and no one over 47 (GPT-3.5) or 56 (GPT-4-mini). Some ethnic groups were absent.
links.quote: Both cohorts diverged significantly from census benchmarks (p < 0.0001 for every variable).

unlisted_practices: Baseline auditing of LLM-generated synthetic patient cohorts against census demographics before integration into medical curricula

screen.reason: Empirical study benchmarking LLMs on demographic representation when generating simulated patient cohorts for medical education. It does not test a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
